tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /paṇa chen shes rin pas mdzad pa'i rten gsum gzhengs tshul dpal 'byor rgya mtsho las sku'i phyag tshad kyi skabs zur du phyung ba bzhugs/ /gnyis pa la tsha
༄༅/ /paṇa chen shes rin pas mdzad pa'i rten gsum gzhengs tshul dpal 'byor rgya mtsho las sku'i phyag tshad kyi skabs zur du phyung ba bzhugs/ /gnyis pa la tsha

tei:div.tei:p: ¿༄༅/ /paṇa chen shes rin pas mdzad pa'i rten gsum gzhengs tshul dpal 'byor rgya mtsho las sku'i phyag tshad kyi skabs zur du phyung ba bzhugs/ /

gnyis pa la tshad ldan dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan dang*/ des na rgyas par bshad pa'o/ / dang po la/ mi ldan pa'i nyes dmigs dang*/ ldan pa'i phan yon no/ /dang po ni/ bde mchog sdom 'byung gi rgyud las/ /mgrin pa lkos ko byin pa ste/ /gsum po rings na skyon chen po/ /sngags pa bdag nyid nges par ni/ gnas las nyams shing bskrad par 'gyur/ /snyan dang shangs dang phyag sor ste/ gsum po thung na skyon chen po/ /dngos grub nges pa 'joms pa dang*/ /de bzhin dpal yang nyams pa 'gyur/ /byin pa zhal dang mkhur tshos te/ /gsum po sbom na skyon che no/ /sngags pa de nyid nges par yang*/ /dpal las ring zhing bdud dgegs 'byung*/ /'gram pa gnyis dang rtsib log ste/ /gsum po zhom na skyon chen po/ /don rnams nyams par 'gyur ba dang*/ /'dir ni bgegs 'byung the tshom med/ /nu ma shangs dang dpral ba ste/ /gsum po yo na skyon chen po/ /sgrub pa po de myur ba ni/ /dgra'i rtsod pas gdung bar 'gyur/ /brla dang dkyu dang nam tshongs te/ /gsum po nyams na skyon chen po/ /chom rkun sogs kyis 'joms pa yi| |'chi bar 'gyur ba the tshom med/ /mig g.yon sna dang rna ba dang*/ /mchu dang dpral ba dag nyams na/ /nges par sngags pa rnams la ni/ /sna tshogs bgegs dang 'chi ba 'ong*/ /gyen du gzigs shing dbugs skyod tshul/ /gdan las g.yo zhing bskyod 'dra na/ /rang gi gnas nas nges 'pho zhing*/ /don rnams 'joms pa nyid du 'gyur/ /mgrin pa nam rdzongs la sogs sku'i/ /skyon ni grangs med zhig tu gnas/ /'dir ni spyan sogs yo ba yi/ /phyag rgya phyag mtshan nor gyur na/ /mya ngan sdug bsngal gyis rab gdungs/ /de phyir skyon rtags bcos par bya/ /rgyab yol dang ni gdugs dang gdan/ /gsum po chung shing dogs pa'i skyon/ /mdza' bos mi bsnyan brjod pa dang*/ /dpal nyams 'chi bar 'gyur ba yin/ /'di dag nyes pa chen po ste/ /legs par rnam dpyad brtag par bya/

gnyis pa ni/ mtshan nyid thams cad yang dag rdzogs/ gzugs mdzes cho ga mthong ba ste/ /dul ba gzo rnams thams cad la/ /legs par mnyam par bzhag pas bri/ /zhi ba la ni zhi ba'i gzugs/ /drag cing 'jigs rung drag po ste/ /dpa' zhing nga rgyal sku dpa'o/ /bzhad pa'i zhal ni sgeg pa ste/ 'di ltar mtshan nyid mtshon byas nas/ /sngags pa rnams kyis thang sku bri/ /las dang po yi sngags pa yi/ /gzugs brnyan la sogs bya ba ste/ thang sku sgrub bya rgya chen gyi/ /dngos grub myur du thob par 'gyur/ zhes sdom 'byung le'u sum bcu par gsungs shing*/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud du yang*/ bris sku'i phan yon rgyas par gsungs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ sdom 'byung 'grel pa la rten pa zhig gzhan du bshad zin mod kyi/ 'dir yang dus 'khor sdom 'byung rtsa 'grel dang*/ kṛ ya sa muts+tsha dang*/ bod snga ma dag gis sha ri'i bus zhus pa'i mdo la brten pa'i phyag tshad mang du bshad pa rnams bsgrigs te rgyas par bshad par bya'o/ /de yang zhal phyag spyan la sangs rgyas kyi sku so so dang*/ 'gro ba gzhan gyi lus so so'i dbang gis lus kyi sor grangs dang*/ mchu zheng la sogs pa shes dgos ste/ dus 'khor 'grel chen du rgyal ba'i longs sku la rang sor brgya nyer lnga mchu zheng mnyam pa dang*/ mi phal pa la/ zheng du rang sor go drug /mchur gya bzhi las med pas mchu zheng mi gab pa dang*/ de gnyis kyi bar byang sems gzhan la yod par gsungs pa cung zad zhib du sbyar na/ mi phal pa la las rlung stong brgyad brgya pa phrag gcig 'gags/ sa dang po thob na brgya dang brgyad/ de nas dgu po re re la sor gnyis gnyis 'phel te/ brgya nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ bcu gcig pa dang bcu gnyis pa la sor gcig 'phel bas brgya nyer lngar gsal bas mi mkhas pa dag /rdo rje sems dpa' bzhengs pa'i tshad/ /gdong pa dgu las 'gyur ba med| |zhi ma khro la zhal tshad brgyad/ /shin du khros la zhal tshad drug

/ces pa 'di kha don du byed cing zhal re la sor bcu gnyis mar bzhag nas/ zhal dgu la brgya dang brgyad yod pa 'di ring dar byas te/ dus 'khor nas sor mo brgya nyer lnga dang*/ sdom 'byung 'grel pa sogs su zhal bcu gnyis ma yang gsungs pa rnams rang dgar 'jug pa dgag pa'i grang don du 'dod pa dag gi ni tshul 'di lta bu khongs su ma chud pas nongs so/ /yang kha gcig /phugs kyi zhal grangs la khyad med kyang zhi khro rnams kyi sor mo la sbom phra yod pas/ zhal gang la sor mo phyed dang bcu gsum ma dang*/ bcu gnyis ma dang*/ phyed dang bcu gcig ma dang*/ shin du khros pa sor mo shin tu sbom pas zhal re re la rang sor dgu mar byed pa yin no/ /zhes kyang zer mod kyi/ de ni mi mthad de/ shin du khros pa de sor mo sbom pa tsam du zhal gyi 'khor yang shin tu che ba'i phyir dang*/ zhi ba la zhal dgu dang*/ zhi ma khro la brgyad/ shin du khros pa la drug la sogs par rang gis khas blangs pa dang yang 'gal zhing*/ dus 'khor sdoms 'byung du longs sku zhal tshad bcu pa zhal re la rang sor phyed dang bcu gsum ma dang*/ bde mchog sogs la sor bcu gnyis ma'i zhal bcu dang*/ phag mo dang*/ bdag med ma sogs dang*/ tshangs pa dbang po nye dbang drag po chu lha rlung lha sor la zhal dgu pa dang*/ gshin rje gshed la sogs pa'i khro bo dang thag bzang ris dang lus ngan dang*/ bden bral dang*/ gshin rje dang me lha dang drag gza' rnams zhal brgyad pa dang*/ ro langs ni zhal bcu gnyis pa dang*/ kṛ ya sa muts+tshar mi'u thung dang*/ tshogs bdag sogs zhal lnga par bshad la/ 'byung po 'dul byed zhal gsum pa/ zhes nag po chen po lta bu rang zhal gsum par bshad pa yang yod par grags pa sogs dang 'gal ba'i phyir ro/ /des na zhal grangs ni dbu che chung dang*/ yan lag ring thung sogs kyis bzhag la/ sor grangs ni/ zhal so so'i bcu gnyis cha 'am phyed dang bcu gsum cha la bzhag nas brtsi bar bya ba yin no/

/de ltar na dang por sor mo brgya nyer lnga pa brjod par bya ste/ gtsug tor sor mo bzhi/ de nas skra 'tshams phyed dang lnga/ de nas mdzod pu sor bzhi ste de ltar zhal gong*/ shangs rtse/ kosko/ mgrin phreng 'og ma'i bar yang de ji lta ba bzhin no/ /de nas snying lte gsang ba'i bar la zhal re re ste/ de ltar na gtsug tor nas gsang gnas kyi bar la zhal lnga'o/ /brla dang rje ngar gyi rkang la zhal do do/ dpyi dpus mo gnyis la sor bzhi bzhi/ long bu man la phyed dang lnga ste/ de ltar gsang gnas nas rting pa'i bar zhal lnga ste/ bcu po thams cad sor mo phyed dang bcu gsum par mnyam pas brgya nyer lnga/ zhabs mthil gyi dkyus la sor mo bcu bzhi ste/ de ni sku'i srid la rtsi don med do/ kha gcig thor cog sbrags pas zhal do ste zhal bcu gnyis bshad zer mod kyi/ kho bos ni sdom 'byung 'grel par ro langs zhal bcu gnyis par bshad pa ma rtogs longs sku zhal bcu gnyis par bshad ma mthong ngo*/ /de bzhin du zheng du brang gi tshangs thig nas phrag pa'i bar la zhal gang*/ bar lhu sor nyi shu/ lag ngar bcu drug /phyag mgo bcu gnyis/ gru mo dang 'khrig mar sor re re/ 'grel chen dang sdom 'byung 'grel par gsungs mod kyi/ sdom grangs drug bcu re phyed dang gsum du gsungs shing mchu zheng gab par gsungs pa dang*/ cung mi 'grig pas na/ gru mo 'khrig ma phyag mgo rnams dus 'khor rgyud kyi rtsa bar ma thon pa 'grel pas kha skangs pa la rags rtsis shor bar snang bas dang po gnyis la sum cha re dbri zhing phyi ma la sor phyed mnan par bya'o/ /'dir ni sor mo brgya dang brgyad pa la ring shos byed pa'i gzo bo sogs kyis bltas na lhu lag shin tu ring par snang mod kyi/ rgyal ba nyid kyis gsungs pa 'di gtso bor bya yi mi phal gyi mig sngar mdzes pa gtso bor ma byed gcig /der ma zad cung zad khros pa'i bde mchog kyai rdor dang*/

dag pa'i byang sems kyi sku ni/ zhal tshad bcu po 'di'i steng nas/ sor phyed phyed kyi cha phri ste sor mo brgya nyi shu pa byas na'ang de ltar snang mod kyi snga ma bzhin no/ /zhal tshad dgu pa rnams la ni/ gtsug tor sor drug nor bu sor gnyis byed kyang dgu la mi thi bar byas/ sngar gyis sor phyed dang lnga pa thams cad bzhi pa dang zhal thams cad sor bcu gnyis par byas nas gzhan 'dra ba la/ spyi dang dpus mo'i sor bzhi po dang gtsug tor gyi sor bzhi po bor ba yin no/ /zhal tshad brgyad pa ni/ gzhan 'jal lugs dgu pa de ji bzhin la/ zhal gyi dkyil 'khor dbyibs gru bzhir mngon pa snga ma las che ba gcig byas la zhal tshad gzhan thams cad zhal de'i rang sor phyed dang bcu gcig ma la zhal du ming bdags shing sor mo bzhi pa rnams phyed dang bzhi par byas pas zhal de'i tshad brgya 'ong ba yin zhing*/ drug pa dang lnga pa dang gsum pa sogs kyang des bsgres nas shes par bya'o/ /dper na zhal lnga pa la bcu pa dang gzhi khyon mnyam pa la zhal nyis 'gyur gyis che ba byas zhal tshad gzhan thams cad de'i phyed phyed la ming du brtags pa bzhin no/ /de bzhin zhal gyi rnam pa yang*/ rgyud las/ khyim bya'i sgo nga til rnam pa/ /gru bzhi dang ni zlum por bcas/ /thun mong sku rnams thams cad kyi/ /zhal gyi dbyibs ni rnam pa bzhi/ /skyes bu che dang lha mo yi/ khyim bya'i sgo nga til gyi dbyibs/ mdzes shing lta na sdug pa yi/ /zhal gyi rnam pa gnyis nyid bya/ /yid dgas sha za 'byung po dang*/ khro bo rnams kyi rnam 'gyur dbyibs/ /zlum po dag dang gru bzhi ste| |zhal ni gnyis dag bya ba yin/ zhes gsungs pas/ zhi zhal la sangs rgyas byang sems kyi khyim bya'i sgo nga*/ lha mo rnams kyi til/ khro zhal la khro bo spyi'i zlum po/ ha cang khros pa'i gru bzhi rnams/ zhal gyi gzhi gru gzhir byas pa'i grwa bzhi ka nas cha phran phyed dang gnyis bcad pa dang*/

gnyis ga nas gnyis gnyis bcad pa dang*/ gnyis ga nas re re bcad pas 'byung par bshad kyang dang po gnyis la logs nas kyang re re bcad dgos la/ zhal bzhi po de 'khor lo bde mchog gi g.yas dang*/ rgyab dang mdun dang g.yon zhal gyi dbyibs su bshad cing*| rim pa ltar sangs rgyas byang sems rnams dang*/ phag mo gzugs can dum skyes ma rnams dang*/ khro mo rnams dang*/ ma mo dang dpa' bo dpa' mo rnams kyi zhal yang de dag dang 'dra bar bya bar gsungs la/ spyan ni rtsa zhal la zlum po zheng du nas bcu dang*/ dkyus la nas bcu bzhi/ rgyab zhal la zheng nas drug dang skyus nas bco brgyad de nya lta bu/ gzhan gnyis la zheng sor gcig dang*/ dkyus sor gnyis pad+ma lta bu bya bar bshad/ nas ni sor gyi brgyad cha la bya bar gsungs so/ spyan rnams ni phal cher khro zhal gyi spyan du snang la/ zhi ba'i spyan ni sangs rgyas rnams la bsam gtan gyi gzigs stangs zhing nas gnyis dang daskyus nas nyer gcig pa gzhu'i rnam pa byang sems rnams la nas bzhi dang nyi shu ste ut+pal lta bu/ lha mo rnams la bde mchog gi nub zhal lta bu'o/ /de ltar zhal phyag rnams ldan lha/ /shin tu zhi dang zhi ma khro/ khro dang shin tu khros pa bzhi// dang po'i phyag tshad gtsor byas nas/ /gzhan rnams khyad par cung zad brjod// phal cher shugs la rtogs par 'gyur/ /dang po la yang longs sprul gnyis// longs sku bzhugs dang bzhengs pa dang*/ /gnyis ka'i thun mong mchu zheng ni// sangs rgyas sor mo brgya nyer lnga/ /zhal re phyed phyed bcu gnyis pa/ /zhal bcur mchu zheng mtshungs phyir ro/ /dag pa'i byang sems longs sku dang*/ /sangs rgyas sprul sku bde dgyes sogs/ /sor phyed bcu po phri ba yi/ /brgya dang nyi shur mchu zheng mnyam/ /sar gnas byang sems longs sku dang*/ /phag mo spyan sor gshegs ma dang*/ /sangs rgyas sprul sku shāka thub sor/ /zhal dgu sor mo brgya dang brgyad/

/dgu brgyad gnyis ka zhi ma khro/ khro bo phal cher zhal tshad brgyad// sor mo dgu bcu drug par 'dod/ /shin tu khros la zhal lnga dang*/ /sor mo drug bcu re gnyis sor/ /zhal tshad gsum pa'ang bshad ces grags/ /rgyal ba'i sprul sku yin na yang*/ khro bo rnams la mtshan dpe yi/ /phyag ring mdzes sogs mi dgos kyi/ /mi sdug bco brgyad la sogs pa/ /gang la gang 'dul nges med yin| |rgyal ba'i zhal tshad bcu po ni/ /gtsug tor skra 'tshams mdzod spu rnams| |sor phyi phyed dang lnga dang bzhi/ shang rtse kos sko mgrin pa yang*/ /de bzhin snying lte gsang gnas rnams/ zhal re phyed bcas bcu gnyis pa'o/ /brla dang rje ngar zhal do do// dpyi dang dpus mo long bu man/ /bzhi bzhi phyed bcas bzhi pa ste/ /zhabs 'thil bcu bzhi 'dir mi bgrang*/ /de bzhin 'doms la'ang zhal bcu ste/ / dbus nas phrag par zhal gang dang*/ /bar lhu phyag ngar phyag mgo rnams/ /nyi shu bcu drug zhal gang ste/ gru mo 'khrig ma sum gnyis re'o/ /gtsug tor dbus su tshud pa yi/ /thor cog srid la bcu gnyis dang*// dpa' bo sems dpa' brgyad dam dgu /thor cog srid la mi rtsi'o/ /zhal la sogs pa'i zheng tshad ni/ /zhal bstod dgu dang zhal bskyed bcu/ zhal smad bdun sogs ci rigs bya/ /snyan zheng gnyis ste srid du bzhi/ /snyan zhal bzhi sogs ci mdzes yin/ /spyan dkyus gsum lhag zheng du ni/ /nas gnyis bzhi sor mdzes par bya/ /smin dkyus bzhi po gzhu lta bu/ /snyan gyi rtse dang thad mnyam ste/ /snyan bug spyan las cung zad dma'/ /smin phrag phyed dang gnyis dbus su/ /mdzod dpu sor gcig zlum zhing mdzes/ /spyan dbus sor gcig bshad pa ni/ /bde mchog khro zhal dbang byas pas/ /smin ma'i phrag dang mnyam pa mdzes/ /spyan gyi nag cha sor gcig ste/ /'bras bu sor gyi lnga cha'o/ /shangs rtse'i zheng ni sor gnyis ste/ /mchu dang kosko'ang de dang mtshungs/

/mchu sgros ma mchu sor gcig dang*/ /ya mchu sor phyed cher mi rung*/ /shang rtse dang ni ya mchu'i bar| |sor gcig bshad pa'ang bde mchog sogs/ /cung zad zhal gdangs la dgongs pas/ /shin du zhi la phyed gnyis lhag /kasko'i dpangs la gnyis bshad pa'ang*/ /de dang 'dra bas cung zad bskyed/ /zhal dkyus sor mo bzhi pa ste| |gra gnyis gyen du cung zad bstod/ /smin ma'i sbom sar nas gnyis te/ snyan gyi sgri kha sor phyed bskor/ /rdo gzhong lta bur sor gcig dang*/ /bu gar sor gcig zlum zhing 'gril/ /mgul zheng sor mo brgyad pa ste/ /snyan 'og mgul bsnyer sor mo dang*/ de nas phra gong zhal re ste/ /sku bstod sbom par sum bcu'o/ /dpung lhu'i sbom sar so drug ste/ gru mor phyed lnga 'khrig mar ni/ / gsum zer 'phras pas phyed dang bzhi/ /phyag 'thil gru bzhi drug zer yang*/ / srid bdun zheng la lnga par bshad/ /gung mo sor lnga 'dzub mo na/ /de'i sen mo'i rtsa bar sleb/ /ming med de las sor phyed ring*/ /de gsum skyes pa mnyam po ste/ /mthe chung de las sor phyed dma'/ /rtse mos ming med sor gcig sleb// mthe bong skye sa sor gsum dma'/ /mdzub mo'i sum char cung mi sleb/ /mthe bong tshigs gnyis mngon pa ste/ gzhan bzhi sum char mngon pa'o/ /sen mo tshigs kyi phyed nas rtsal/ /mdzub brtser cung zad ma sleb pa'o/ /byang stod sor mo bco brgyad ste/ /byang smad bcu gnyis sta zur smad/ bco brgyad byin gyis 'phel ba'o/ /brla'i zheng tshad sor bcu ste/ /nya la sor drug byin bzhug bzhi// zhabs mthil che sar sor drug dang*/ chung sar phyed dang bzhi yin te/ /gab pa'i tshul gyis cung zad skyung*/ /mthe bong sor gsum sboms su gnyis/ /gzhan kun mchu zheng rims kyis skyung/ /bzhugs pa rdo rje'i skyil dkrung las/ /dpus mo'i rtse nas rtse yi bar/ /zhal tshad bzhi ru nges pas na/
/zla gdan steng nas mdzod dpu dang*/ /mchu zheng mnyam po yin pa la/ /bod 'ga' dkyil dkrung dpangs dma' :par

[ bar ] / /mthong nas skyed par sor bzhi :mnan [ bsnan ] / / des na shang rtse dang mnyam zer/ /dpus mo'i dpangs la sor mo bzhi/ /nga pa sor gsum steng du ste/ /rting pa gnyis par sor bzhi lhag /gzhengs pa g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum dang*/ /bzlog dang sa ga zlum po dang*/ /rol pa la sogs gang gsungs rnams/ /dang po bzhi po sor mo rnams/ /logs su bstan par khyad par med/ /dang po gnyis po mtho lnga'i :mgyangs [ rgyang ] / /bshad kyang zhabs gnyis tshad ldan du/ /btang nas brkyang bskum tshul bzhin du/ /byas pa nyid kyis kun la 'grub/ /sa ga sting ma'i bar sor bzhi| brla dang byin pa drang por srang*/ /bzlum po de dang 'dra ba la/ /dpus mo phyir la gdeng pa'o/ /rol pa g.yon gyi sor mo ni/ /mdun du drang bstan de'i long bur/ /g.yas pa'i :bsting [ rting ] pa bkan nas ni/ /sor mo logs su bstan pa nyid/ /g.yas rol zhes bya g.yon rol bzlog /mnyam pa sa ga lta bu la/ /bar med mnyam par gcer ba'o/ /gzhan yang bzhugs stabs mang bshad pas/ /dkyil chog sa chog skabs rnams dang*/ /rang rang mngon rtogs rnams su blta/ /de rnams zhal tshad bcu pa'i tshad/ /dgu pa la ni zhal ras nyid/ /cung zad bskyed de brgyad po rnams| |rang sor phyed dang bcu gcig la/ /zhal re'i ming de mdor na ni/ / mchu la bcu cha bri ba la/ /zheng la bcu cha kun du bskyed/ /de bzhin zhal tshad lnga pa la/ /mchu kun phyed la zhal mi ste/ /zheng kun 'dab kyis bskyed pas 'grub// 'on kyang sbom sar sbom zhing grims/ /phra sar nyag cing mkhrang la 'gril/ /:zhi brgyas [ zhib rgyas ] sdom 'byung 'grel pa sogs/ /gzhan du blta zhing mkhas la bslab| |gtso bor rgya bod mkhas pa yis/ /phyag rjes nan tan gyis brtsal nas| |bltas shing dpyad la lag len gdab/ /slob dpon blun po'i ngag rgyun dang*| |rang gis sdug goms ngan lang gis/ /dad ldan yo byad chud mi gzan// thub pa chu lon mar grags sogs/

/phyag tshad rnams dang mi mthun yang*// mkhas pas byas shing grags che ba/ /kun gyis mthun snang grub pa yi/ /kun la mdzes par snang ba 'ga'/ /shes na'ang mkhas pa'i phyag rjes bltos/ /phyag ni gnyis ka'am gang rung gcig /mnyam bzhag yod na 'gying med gsungs/ / phyag mang yin na 'gal ba med/ /phyag g.yas lding la g.yon 'gying dang*/ / g.yon lding bzlog bya zhabs stabs kyang*/ /gang gi phyogs su dbu 'gying yang*/ / bzlog na 'gyel ba'i skyon du 'gyur/ /zhal 'gying gang du byas phyogs kyi/ / bzlog par byang bstod 'bur ba dang*/ /rang sar sta zur 'bur ba gces/ / sum khugs drang na mdzes par 'gyur/ /drang srong cha phyed skem pa dang*/ gzhon nu'i cha lags gzhon sha rgyas/ /pho rnams stod rgyas smad zhum dang*/ /mo rnams de las bzlog par bya/ khro bo gar gyi nyams dgu ldan/ /rgyan dang mdangs kyis sgeg pa rnams/ /'gying dang rol pas dpa' ba ste/ /spyan log khro gnyer mi sdug pa| |'dzum zhing :gzhad [ bzhad ] 'dra dgod pa'i nyams/ /hūm̐ phaṭa sgrog 'dra drag shul che/ /mtshon cha phyar lding 'jigs su rung*/ /spyan dmar gzhon sha snying rje'i nyams/ /zhal gdangs rkan sdeb dang 'dra rngams/ /gnyen lcug sha 'jam zhi ba'i nyams/ /dbu skra zhal gang gyen rdzes shing*/ /ag tshoms smin ma'ang gyen rdzes 'khyog /mdor na yid la legs shar ba/ /lag tu btab pas nyams kun 'byung*| |yid 'phrog bstan pa'i phyi mor 'gyur/ khri rgyab bshad par bya ba la/ / dus 'khor rtsa rgyud kyi dum bu las/ khri la khri bstan dang*/ khri gdong dang*/ khri rkang dang*/ khri rmang gnyis dang*/ ba gaṃ dang*/ lan kan naṃ pu shu ste/ bdun po byang phyogs sde tshan bdun dang dag pa sbyar ba tsam dang*/ rgyab yol la rgyan sna drug phyin drug dang sbyar te/ bya khyung ka ru ṇa ste snying rje dang*/ chu srin pu ra ṇa ste grong khyer dang*/ mi chung bya ra ṇa ste tshogs bdag dang*/ glang chen gu ra ṇa ste bla ma dang*|

ri dgas sha ra ṇa ste dbang phyug dang*/ klu phrug nā ra ṇa ste sgrol mdzad rnams rim pa bzhin shes rab nas sbyin pa'i bar phar phyin drug lugs bzlog dang dag pa sbyar nas gsungs shing*/ khri la la seng ge glang chen rta rma bya shang shang gi 'degs byed dang*/ nor bu dang nyi zla dang pad+ma'i gdan rnams ni/ rim pa bzhin stobs dang*/ so so yang dag par rig pa dang*/ dbang bcu dang*/ smon gnas shes pa dang*/ byang chub kyi phyogs dang*/ don dam e dang*/ kun rdzob baṃ dang*| sgrib pa gsum gyi ma gos pa rnams dag pa dang*/ tshad med bzhi dang bsdu dngos bzhi la sogs pa rnams mtshon par byed pa seng rgyan dang*/ dar gyi blo bstan la sogs pa gsungs so/ bod snga ma dag gis khri la brtsegs nyi shu rtsa gcig la sogs pa'i spros pa dang*/ rgyab yol rgyas pa phub la zhol brtags pa lta bu dang*/ 'bring po pad 'dab lta bu dang*/ bsdus pa lcags rtse ma dang*/ sgong gzugs ma la sogs pa'i lag len mang du snang na yang*/ 'bring po tsam gyis tshad dang gzo lugs shes na gzhan rnams shugs la 'byung pas 'di skad ces bya ste| gdan khri 'phang du zhal drug bya/ /sa 'dzin zhal gang de steng du/ /rdo rje'i gdan phreng so bzhi'i spangs/ /nor bu sum rtsegs sor gnyis te/ lha snam sor brgya nor bu gsum/ /phyed dang gnyis re de steng su/ /pad 'dab sor mo bcu drug spangs/ /nor bu nyis rtseg sor re dang*/ /sum cha re ste bre sor bzhi/ /de steng nor bu snga ma tsam/ /glang rgyab sor mo phyed dang bzhi/ /nor bu sor gang bzhi cha'i tshad/ /seng khri sor mo bcu pa ste/ /nor bu snga ma tsam steng du/ /bang chung sor do bzhi cha'i tshad/ /bad chen sor bzhi bzhi gsum ste/ /tsaṇ+ḍa sor do bzhi chas dman/ /steng khebs sor gcig bzhi cha'o/ /srid du sa 'dzin zhal bcu gsum| |lhas rnams sor bdun zhal bcu gcig /seng khri zhal brgyad sor bzhi brgyab/

/da chen zhal tshad bcu yin zhing*/ /gzhan rnams skyong 'bur phugs la shes/ /'on kyang zhib du sbyor 'dod na/ /tsaṇ+ḍa bad las sor bzhi'i btung*/ / de bas sten khebs ser do bcag bad chung bad las sor drug tu/ /de bas nor bu sor dos dman/ de bas seng khri sor dos bcag /de 'og nor bu sor gsum bsring*/ /de bas glang rgyab sor bzhi bsring*/ /de 'og nor bu steng dang mnyam| |de ba'i bre ni sor gang thung*/ /nor bu gnyis ni 'phang tsam bsring*/ / pad 'dab rtsa ba so gang bsring*/ /'dab ma'i rtse mo sor lnga bsring/ /nor bu gnyis dang lha snam dag/ /sor mo do do phyir la skyed/ /nor bu gsum pa'o snga ma bzhin| |rdor phreng sor dos sa 'dzin ni/ /sor mo gsum chas bsring bar bya/ / rgyab yol sku tshad nyis 'gyur dang*/ /zhal gang tshad kyi tshangs thig gdab/ /'og nas steng du zhal lnga dang*| |sor gang tshad kyis rtags byas la/ /de nas steng du'ang de tsam bskyed/ /steng 'og rtags nas g.yas g.yon du/ /bya rog rjes btsan thig gcig gdab/ /de la dpung khri'i steng 'byung mod/ 'on kyang mtha' gnyis sor lnga la/ /stod nas thig gdab ci mdzes bya/ tshangs thig dpung thig 'dzoms sa nas/ /steng gi phyogs su zhal do nur/ /nor bu ma gtogs sku de yi// zla steng gtsug tor bar tshad kyi/ /srad bus dpung khri'i steng nas bskor/ rtse mor cung bsnan g.yas g.yon du/ /cung zad steng stod ci mdzes bya/ /rgyab yol dpung bar sor brgyad tsam/ /bsnan la stod brgyas dbyibs legs bya/ /bskor thig sna yi ci ran dang*/ /'og tu tshangs thig g.yas g.yon du/ /zhal bzhi sor lnga'i tshad tsam gyi/ /sa nas gyen 'thur thig re gdab/ /de dag rgyab yol phyir rgya'i tshad| |stod rgyas smad phyogs cung zad zhum/ /pad 'dab zlum rgyas dbyibs 'dra bya| |mtha' skor me ri pa ṭa dang*/ /rdo rje phreng dang zlum skor rnams/ /sor mo phyed dang bzhi dang ni/

/sor do dang ni sor brgyad tsam/ /de dag bar bar mu tig phreng*/ /sor mo phyed phyed mdzes pas brgyan/ /de nang bar skor ldem pa gtso/ /bkod legs mdzes shing khyad 'phags bya/ /lugs 'di ding sang mdzes par grags/ /'on kyang phyi dus gdan khri rnams/ /bzhengs pa shin tu nyung bar snang*/ /shoms na shin tu gal che bas/ /gang 'grub nan tan bskyed par bya/ gcig zhus// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ stag tshang lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen gyi bka' 'bum/shes rin pas mdzad pa'i dpal 'byor rgyal mtsho las sku yi phyag tshad kyi skabs zur du phyung ba/ -PAGE 316--PAGE 315-- PAGE 302-
